authoritative_sources.title: TNAU Crop Production Guide - Agriculture & Horticulture
authoritative_sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) & Department of Agriculture, Govt of Tamil Nadu
scope: Paddy / Rice agronomy, seed rate, spacing, water management (AWD)
Millets and Pulses package of practices
Commercial crops (Sugarcane, Cotton) and Vegetables (Tomato, Chilli, Brinjal)
Soil Test Crop Response (STCR) targeted fertilizer recommendations

authoritative_sources.title: Major Uses of Pesticides Registered Under the Insecticides Act, 1968
authoritative_sources.publisher: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIBRC), Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (PPQS)
scope: Approved chemical label claims (active ingredient, formulation, approved crops)
Dosage per hectare and per acre
Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI) in days
Re-entry Intervals (REI) and Toxicity Triangle Classification
Target pests, insects, and fungal pathogens

authoritative_sources.title: ICAR National Research Centre for Integrated Pest Management
authoritative_sources.publisher: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR-NCIPM), New Delhi
scope: Economic Threshold Levels (ETL) for key crop insect pests
Pheromone trap installation protocols and monitoring schedules
Bio-control agents (Trichogramma, Chrysoperla, Trichoderma)
Botanical sprays (Neem Oil / Azadirachtin formulations)

authoritative_sources.title: Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS) Agromet Advisory Guidelines
authoritative_sources.publisher: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
scope: District-level 5-day weather forecast interpretation
Extreme event alerts: heavy precipitation, high wind spray hazards, heat stress
Bi-weekly crop-specific agrometeorological advisories

authoritative_sources.title: myScheme National Platform for Agricultural Welfare Schemes
authoritative_sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India & State Agriculture Departments
scope: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) eligibility and eKYC rules
PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana) premium rates and cut-off deadlines
PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop - Micro Irrigation) subsidy tiers (55% / 45%)
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) 4% subsidized interest rate guidelines
Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme (KAVIADP)
